sheaf noun

also sheaves, bundle (of corn), bunch (of herbs)

classical

Varr. RR 1.49 (Lewis & Short)
Col. 11.2.40: manipulōs obligāre (Lewis & Short)

manipulus, manipulī m.

noun, second declension

a handful, a bundle (of corn, hay, herbs)

From manus: as much as fills the hand.

Other words

  • merges, mergitis f. — a sheaf

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Verg. G. 2.517: cereālis mergite culmī (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • et multā dūram stipulā filicumque maniplīs sternere subter humum

    and to strew the hard ground beneath with plenty of straw and bundles of fernVerg. G. 3.297–298

See also harvest, reap, stubble, hay, grain.
